fields.subject: Shard Targeting Values
fields.condition: While its Shards dictionary does not contain the shard identifier of an entry in the ShardsValues passed to Merge
fields.response: add that shard identifier with its own new parameter set and copy each of the entry's parameters into it; an entry whose parameter dictionary is null or empty is added as a shard with an empty parameter set, as Merge(IList<short>) does
fields.postcondition: every shard identifier present in the source collection is present in this collection
